question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e666a901f5bdc3d0ea1b8c1f65c09ca6e3fde92cb9873642297a266447832890.png] Logic follow here is that the first letter is decreased by 5 and second letter is decreased by 10. Option 1) TQ - OG [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90a59b9ff8f7874726033d1604c3418f7bdb2137c4a20fd7b2bdce4b75155016.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcf0ab516fa89902a29ec94fc42339706c345db77e482b3112a8d985037266aa.png] Option 2) ZW - UM
